decision: Ship a read-only YouTube Data API gem under RecordingStudio::YouTube, with OAuth metadata and no second client
why: The host must search and read public data with only an API key, and later reuse the same client with a user token

decision: Do not implement generic OAuth, token storage, or Publications records in this gem
why: Those jobs already belong to other Recording Studio gems. A Google account is not a YouTube channel

decision: Follow RecordingStudio_web_search for Net::HTTP, config, errors, and soft AI tool registration

decision: Read the API key from youtube_api_key, then from youtube
why: The injected secret name is youtube. Hosts can still set youtube_api_key. Values stay out of logs, errors, and docs

decision: Store quota costs in one table dated 2026-09-15
why: Google's calculator puts search.list on a 100-call Search Queries budget at 1 unit, not the older 100-unit story. captions.download has no published unit cost, so the table leaves it nil

decision: List and download captions only for an authorized editor. Do not add transcript
